item.title: github: Code scanning adds a mitigated alert dismissal reason
item.description:
Code scanning now supports dismissing alerts with the reason “Mitigated” when the vulnerability still exists in code but is offset by external controls, such as a web application firewall or network protections.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: CodeQL 2.26.3 improves GitHub Actions queries and JavaScript modeling
item.description:
CodeQL 2.26.3 adds source modeling for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Vue, and updates several GitHub Actions queries for better accuracy. It is a CodeQL release used by GitHub code scanning.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Customize code scanning default setup at scale
item.description:
GitHub added a new repository property, github-codeql-config-file, that lets you apply a custom configuration file to code scanning default setup. This gives you control over how CodeQL runs on repositories at scale.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Code scanning shows AI security detections on pull requests
item.description:
GitHub code scanning now shows AI-powered security detections on pull requests. The feature expands coverage to languages and frameworks not currently supported by CodeQL.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Periodic code scanning of inactive repositories
item.description:
GitHub code scanning now supports scheduled security scans for repositories with no pushes or pull requests for six months or longer. This helps organizations keep inactive repositories under periodic review.

  • Source: GitHub
